verdict.rationale: The only RFE-related evidence is a sample prompt for the firm's Visalaw AI product, "Review this RFE and list every deadline and required item." That tool is aimed at immigration teams, and its general petition-drafting claim shows the firm's ecosystem touches RFE work, but none of the firm's own practice pages describe responding to an RFE or NOID for a founder client. Missing for 10: documented attorney-led RFE response service, any NOID mention, founder-facing description of post-filing evidence response work, and independent corroboration or outcomes.
